consignes.name: Nicolas Dupont-Aignan
consignes.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D sprite animation sheet. EXACTLY TWELVE full-body figures in FOUR columns and THREE rows on true transparent background, generous transparent gutters and outer margins, no shadows or ground, no text, labels, grid, extra props. Every figure faces RIGHT in identical side/three-quarter view. Image1 is the user-approved FACE/CLOTHING identity reference. Image2 is the existing COMBAT BODY reference: reproduce its FIRST FIGURE's exact large-head caricature proportions, face, navy clothing and short compact limbs. Image3 is Philippe: ONLY use his low grounded footwork and inked game rendering as motion/style reference, never his face/clothes.
CRITICAL ANIMATION COHERENCE: same head shape, same face angle and neutral determined expression, same head diameter, torso length, leg length, colors, silhouette volume, camera and drawing scale in all12 cells. Build a genuine coherent looping sequence, not twelve unrelated drawings. Both fists always up near chest/chin, no punching. No floating feet, marching, high knees, jumping or crossed legs.
ROW1 figures0..3: FOUR DISTINCT sequential combat-IDLE animation drawings. Stable wide staggered foot placement in all4; both soles fully on SAME baseline. 0 relaxed high guard, 1 slight forward weight transfer and elbows inward/forward, 2 knees bend a little and chin tucks with hands closer to face, 3 shifts weight gently back and elbows open, smoothly returning to0. Visible life in shoulders/arms/stance but restrained. Feet never move in this idle row. Each drawing distinct, no duplicates.
ROWS2+3 figures4..11: EIGHT distinct sequential low COMBAT SHUFFLE steps. Body stays in guard, small steps similar to Philippe. Facing RIGHT, lead foot on RIGHT. 4 initial staggered stance, 5 lead shoe slides forward touching floor, 6 weight settles on lead foot and rear heel peels only slightly, 7 rear foot slides forward very close to floor, 8 feet somewhat closer and weight centered, 9 lead foot reaches next contact still close to floor, 10 rear foot starts following, 11 weight returns near initial stance and cycle closes to4. Only tiny toe/heel clearance, shoes never rise above the other ankle. Smooth compact low footwork, no knee up. Stationary head size and face: NO head turn, no changing expression or hairstyle between frames. Keep full figure visible in every cell.
Subject: Nicolas Dupont-Aignan. Preserve this approved character's unmistakable identity throughout all twelve animation drawings.
